evidence.blocker: Compiled Rust parser inside the extension (same coverage problem as rtoml), and its parser source is a git branch rather than a crates.io release; the family relation of lava-sh/toml to toml-rs/toml was not established. Not built from source in this round.

excluded.reason: Its parser is not an independent code base: the sdist Cargo.toml takes toml, toml_parser and toml_edit from git forks of toml-rs/toml (lava-sh/toml rev b1581597 for TOML 1.0.0, toml_parser 1.0.5+spec-1.0.0; rev b3ab4b9d for TOML 1.1.0, toml_parser 1.1.5+spec-1.1.0), not from crates.io releases. Their toml_parser src/ shares 94.1% and 97.3% of distinct non-comment lines (>25 chars) with crates.io toml_parser 1.1.5, and their toml src/ 95.3% and 96.5% with crates.io toml 1.2.1, above the ~70% fork-exclusion threshold. The toml_parser family is already selected in this cell through rtoml (upstream toml 1.1.8 over toml_parser 1.1.5), so toml-rs would add a near-identical fork rather than a new parser.

fork_overlap_evidence.method: distinct stripped non-comment lines longer than 25 characters in crates/<crate>/src/**/*.rs present in the crates.io release src/
